relations.subject: Caroline Augusta Foley Rhys Davids
relations.evidence: Honorary Secretary of the Pali Text Society which had been started by T. W. Rhys Davids to transcribe and translate Pāli Buddhist texts in 1881. She held that position from 1907 until her husband's death in 1922
